observations.behavior: Geometry loads remove zero-volume models before small-unit detection and multipart detection; project settings loads skip this path. load_old_project is initialized false and has no assignments in this pinned source.

Model statistics use a float volume accumulator and normal-part mesh volumes times the absolute determinant of each volume matrix and the first instance matrix. Later instances do not multiply model volume.
Original removed_objects_with_zero_volume removes ModelObjects whose volume is strictly below1e-10, preserving surviving order.
Native unit detection uses8 mm3 for inches and0.008 mm3 for meters; meters wins. Imperial detection checks all cut relatives with matching ID/checksum/connector count.
Native information dialog selects info.svg at64px; title The volume of the object is zero, message Objects with zero volume removed, one OK button.

implementationScope: Structured Orca/Prusa3MF geometry loads call the pinned original Model/TriangleMesh worker, acknowledge removal before committing, and retain the current document on all-empty/cancel/failure. Unit classification is available to the next implementation step, but unit-conversion UI is not yet wired.
remaining: Native unit conversion prompts and explicit imperial import
